title: Copy and paste in a pane on Linux: Ctrl+Shift+C and Ctrl+Shift+V
notes: On Linux the page sees Ctrl+C before the Edit menu does, and xterm takes it as SIGINT, so copying out of a pane only works from Edit > Copy. Ctrl+Shift+C also arrives as ^C. Bind Ctrl+Shift+C and Ctrl+Shift+V on non-mac as terminal actions.

comments.body: PR #74: Ctrl+Shift+C / Ctrl+Shift+V copy and paste in a pane off a mac, as terminal-copy and terminal-paste rows. Mac unbound, Cmd keys reach the menu. Version 1.12.0. Not run in the app.
